name: Low Clearance
spec: yellow diamond with black legend 12 FT 6 IN between two black arrows pointing up and down
meaning: The overpass ahead is low; tall vehicles cannot pass.

snippets.back: A restricted-clearance warning requires an overheight vehicle to use another route.
A low-clearance sign means vehicles or loads taller than the clearance shown cannot fit under the structure ahead.
Give a truck enough following clearance to react if it strikes an object that could then hit your vehicle.
Following distance is counted in seconds behind the vehicle ahead, while bicycle clearance in a shared lane is a fixed three feet to the side.
The depressed foot brake must keep at least one inch of clearance above the floorboard.
When passing or overtaking a bicyclist on any road, a driver must leave at least three feet of clearance, whether or not a white Pass three feet min sign is posted.
Pass trucks solely with room sans speeding, checked mirrors, legal ground, brisk cab clearance, mirror confirmed reentry right, and sustained pace after.
Back slowly in an S-shaped path while repeatedly checking forward and rearward clearance.
